data.q: Which method is used to define a GET endpoint in Minimal APIs?
data.e: Minimal APIs use app.MapGet(), app.MapPost(), app.MapPut(), app.MapDelete(), etc. to map HTTP verbs.

data.q: How do you capture a route parameter named 'id' in a Minimal API endpoint?
data.e: Route parameters are defined with curly braces in the route template and bound to handler parameters by name.

data.q: Which interface is implemented by the Results helper class to produce IResult?
data.e: Results.* methods return IResult implementations. Minimal APIs use IResult instead of IActionResult.

data.q: How do you bind a request body to a parameter in a Minimal API POST endpoint?
data.e: Minimal APIs automatically infer body binding for complex types. [FromBody] is optional but supported.

data.q: Which method registers an endpoint filter that runs for all endpoints in a group?
data.e: Endpoint filters are added via AddEndpointFilter on a RouteGroupBuilder or individual endpoint.

data.q: What is the correct way to return a 404 Not Found with a custom object in Minimal APIs?
data.e: Results.NotFound() accepts an optional value object to serialize as the response body.

data.q: Which NuGet package is required to enable OpenAPI/Swagger generation for Minimal APIs in .NET 8?
data.e: Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi is the official package for built-in OpenAPI support in .NET 8+. Swashbuckle/NSwag are third-party alternatives.

data.q: How do you apply a route prefix to a group of Minimal API endpoints?
data.e: MapGroup creates a RouteGroupBuilder with a shared prefix. All endpoints mapped on the group inherit the prefix.

data.q: Which of the following is a valid way to add validation to a Minimal API endpoint using the built-in validation (as of .NET 8)?
o: Use the Validate() extension on the route handler builder
Validation is not supported in Minimal APIs
data.e: In .NET 8+, you can use builder.Validate<T>() or builder.AddEndpointFilter<ValidationFilter<T>>() for minimal validation.

data.q: How do you inject a scoped service (e.g., DbContext) directly into a Minimal API handler?
o: Add parameter of the service type to the handler delegate
data.e: Minimal APIs support constructor-style injection via handler parameters. [FromServices] is optional. HttpContext.RequestServices is also available.

data.q: What is the purpose of the TypedResults class introduced in .NET 8?
o: To provide strongly-typed IResult implementations for better OpenAPI generation
data.e: TypedResults returns concrete types (e.g., Ok<T>, Created<T>) that improve OpenAPI schema generation and type safety.

data.q: Which method is used to map a fallback endpoint that handles unmatched routes (SPA fallback)?
data.e: MapFallbackToFile serves a specific file (e.g., index.html) for unmatched routes, commonly used for SPAs.

data.q: How do you constrain a route parameter 'id' to integers only?
data.e: Route constraints are specified with a colon and constraint name, e.g., {id:int}, {id:guid}, {id:alpha}.

data.q: What is the recommended way to handle exceptions globally in Minimal APIs?
data.e: Global exception handling middleware (UseExceptionHandler) is recommended. Endpoint filters can also handle exceptions per endpoint/group.

data.q: Which of the following correctly returns a 201 Created response with a Location header in Minimal APIs?
o: return Results.CreatedAtRoute("GetUser", new { id = user.Id }, user);
data.e: Results.Created, Results.CreatedAtRoute, and TypedResults.Created all produce 201 with Location header. TypedResults provides strong typing.

data.q: How do you enable rate limiting for a specific Minimal API endpoint?
data.e: RequireRateLimiting is an extension on IEndpointConventionBuilder to apply a named rate limiting policy.
